column1: # INDIGENOUS PROJECTION — ANNUAL NATURAL-INCREASE ASSUMPTIONS (post-2021)
# Applied to the Indigenous population AFTER the last census anchor (2021).
# The rest of Canada's population (denominator) comes from the main simulation
# and keeps receiving immigration; the Indigenous population does NOT (new
# immigrants are treated as non-Indigenous). So the Indigenous *share* evolves
# from the interplay of higher Indigenous natural increase vs. immigration-fed
# growth of the total.
# Modelling choices worth knowing:
#  - Fertility is assumed to CONVERGE DOWN to the national (below-replacement)
#    level. A below-replacement group cannot naturally increase forever
#    identity_ni must eventually go NEGATIVE.
#  - BUT it stays positive for the first couple of decades because of
#    POPULATION MOMENTUM: the Indigenous age structure is very young (median
#    age ~33 vs ~41 nationally)
